description: Create many tickets in Zendesk in a single request. Accepts an array of up to 100 ticket objects. The operation is handled asynchronously — a background job is queued and you receive a job_status payload with an initial status of 'queued' or 'working'. Poll the job_status URL or use zendesk.get_job_statuses2 to check for completion and view per-ticket results. Use when creating multiple tickets at once or seeding test data. This action is irreversible — tickets created cannot be easily undone once the job completes. Ensure the tickets list is accurate before submitting.
